# Vendored

`jsQR.js` — MIT, https://github.com/cozmo/jsQR

A phone reads the code in the page itself. Safari has no BarcodeDetector, so
without this the only way in on an iPhone is typing a token. Kept here rather
than fetched from anywhere: the page is served by your own core, on your own
network, and should not reach out to a third party to let you in.
